deviations: SCR-069 / empty: the stop's source and holder line is composed from §6.1 L630's form ('→ {price} · … · held by Bybit (exchange)'), row 1's price '—' (L670) and E30-D02 sl.source.profile 'from your profile: 200 ticks' (row 1's copy, L670; E30-D02 §6 orders the source before the holder); the anatomy's '1 R = 27.50 USDT (0.22 % of equity)' part needs an entry price and a size, so it is not drawn.

SCR-069 / empty: breakeven is drawn unticked with its R blank (row 1: 'targets blank'; the spec gives no empty-state breakeven); its '→ stop to …' line (e32.be.line) and the app-managed sentence (L637-638, which quotes 63,900.0) need an entry and a stop price, so neither is drawn.

SCR-069 / empty: no preview line — nothing is previewed before an entry price and a size exist (row 1 names only Place's reason); the single target's line keeps only its holder words 'held by Bybit, attached with the order' (§6.1 L634-635; its '= price · profit' part needs a target).

SCR-069 / editing · TP ladder: the rungs reuse §4.1 L338-340's line grammar 'TP n [ % ] % · [ R ] R · price · qty · profit' (one ladder grammar across SCR-064 and SCR-069, §1.1); the profits are §4.1's for the same tp_ladder(0.250, …) call (L354), which row 3 cites for its quantities; the rung class label and the note (info glyph, secondary text, no fill) are this sheet's composition (the spec names no component for them).

SCR-069 / editing · LIVE arm is 912 px wide (the kit's SCR-069 modal is 720): its footer — the CMP-229 pill, Cancel and the T2 Place with the full label (§3.6 L242-246) — needs about 830 px in one row (kit estimate); the three footers are stacked in the row's order (LOCKED, ARMED, UNKNOWN), one shows at a time.

SCR-069 / blocked: the spec names no slot for SCR-069's preview refusal (SCR-065 row 24 puts it in its row 14's slot): the class line (refusal.account_locked, lock glyph, §3.5's pattern) is drawn under the preview line it answers; 'Close position…' is drawn as if a position is open on Main (row 17: only where one is open).

SCR-069 / blocked: row 17's Role column names only the banner's alert, while §3.5 L211 and §3.7 L263 make the preview's account_locked class line a second assertive alert that repeats the banner; the board states the order (the banner's alert once, then the class line's once, when the preview answers) and does not settle whether the class line goes role="status" (or stays silent) while the banner holds: an O-row for the spec author (.md §10); the node note follows the answer.

SCR-069 / viewer-read-only: drawn for the viewer ('Your role can't place orders.'); row 14's other trigger, a read-mode account, is the inset beside the annotation (its notice 'You can view this account, not trade it.'); the values are §6.1's draft, read-only (the row gives none); the breakeven checkbox and the radios keep their look (the kit has no read-only form for them), noted read-only.

SCR-069 / E33 extension point: §6.4's 'may add' and 'must not change' parts are marked with 16 px discs in the frame's left inset (A, B: may add; 1-5: must not change), positioned from the kit's height estimates and re-placed live; items with no region on this frame (the algo.oco_* events, the refusal pattern) are legend rows marked '–'.
Every control is a composition from tokens, named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only, and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance or swap its glyph.

Segmented controls draw the anatomy's words verbatim, the selected one in capitals as written (BUY, LIMIT; §5.1 L458, §6.1 L628) and marked by the selected fill; the unit switch's '*' (L330) is that fill.
A focus ring is a 2 px inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs padding, so it sits 2 px off the control and adds 4 px on each side to the layout (CMP-039).
The anatomies' ASCII '->' (§6.1 L630, L636) is drawn as '→', the glyph of the keyed strings (e32.be.line L286; §3.4 L189).
A validity hold (§3.6 L250-252: 'the host's call') is drawn as the control's own look with its reason as a description and no lock glyph: the spec does not draw it.
Frame captions, annotation labels, board titles, source lines and footers are board chrome, not product copy.
1 px outlines use cvlib's default stroke (1 px, inner) without binding border.hairline; 2 px boundaries and rings bind border.thick / border.focus (frames stay small: FRAME_NOTE).

Modal sizes are kit choices (the spec gives none): SCR-064 640 px wide, SCR-065 800 px (its minimum width 640 px collapses notional and cum. notional, §5.2 L519), SCR-069 720 px; heights hug the content except the 50-row frame (12 body rows, §5.2 L527).
No close (×) control is drawn in the dialog headers: §3.1 L152 names the verb, the object and the environment pill only; Esc closes (L151).

Every number is JetBrains Mono (§3.1 L155) in fields, cells, tiles and the read-out pairs; a number inside a sentence keeps the sentence's Inter, because a cvsheet v1 text node carries one typography.

Frames are named 'SCR-0xx / <state>' (§0 L47), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so no section can address a node inside a frame: every frame is rendered whole in one section (the kit keeps each under 24000 bytes; one over the 12000-byte budget is listed in live_checks).
